data.narrative:
Blackstar is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Daniel Edrisian, former OpenAI Codex engineer whose prior venture (Alex, YC W24) was acqui-hired by OpenAI in September 2025. The company has raised $12M to date. The relevant comp universe includes 9 private AI & Software firms and 1 public comparable (Palantir), though strict peer filtering—controlling for stage, valuation tier, and business model—yielded insufficient narrow matches for traditional peer-median analysis.

Given limited comparable data at this stage, the stage-progression method is the primary applicable valuation tool. Applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $12M raised proxy—a standard marker for Seed-to-next-stage progression in AI & Software—yields $30M. This reflects typical dilution and milestone-based valuation expansion observed in the sector.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $34M, centered on $30M. Key uncertainties include the absence of publicly traded direct-stage peers, making external market validation difficult, and the limited transaction history within the narrow peer cohort. The valuation remains sensitive to near-term technical progress, revenue traction (if any), and market reception of the company's AI offering. Further diligence on unit economics and product-market fit would be warranted before commitment.
